chunks: And ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī asked him about a young girl for whom no woman is available to wash her. He said:
The one most closely related to her among the men should wash her.

key_terms.أَوْلَى: the one with the strongest priority or closest right

ai.seo_question: Who should wash a deceased young girl if no woman is available?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the washing of a deceased young girl when no woman is available to perform the غسل. In that case, the man who is most closely related to her has priority in washing her.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.432 - Ammar al-Sabati asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a young girl for whom no woman is available to wash her.
Imam (as) replied: "The one most closely related to her among the men should wash her."
